method: One independent generation call per material. No atlas, contact sheet, crops, or compositing. Original generated PNGs copied unmodified.

assets.prompt:
Generate an image with the following prompt, dont change it(DO NOT CHANGE THIS PROMPT, IT'S ALREADY AN IMPROVED PROMPT) - 

object: dark blue-black tinted curtain-wall glass
material: a SINGLE flat pane of dark blue-black glass, very faint cloudy reflection, subtle believable muted reflection
constraints: no pane divisions, no frame, no city silhouette baked into the glass, no reflected buildings, no visible environment
asset: one individual environment material texture for a 3D city game
composition: flat orthographic albedo texture filling the entire image edge to edge, square 1:1, seamlessly tileable
style: realistic material, PS1 or early Source game texture softness, low to medium frequency detail; not cartoon pixel art
lighting: even diffuse neutral illumination
aspect ratio: 1:1
Avoid: atlas, grid of different assets, contact sheet, actual building scene, perspective, frame, text, logos, objects, excessive grunge or damage, mirrored stain patterns, oversharpening, strong cast shadows, excessive glare
